categories.main_business_segments: S.F. Holding Co., Ltd. operates primarily in comprehensive logistics services including time-sensitive express delivery, economic express, freight transport, cold chain and pharmaceutical logistics, same-city instant delivery, and supply chain and international logistics. The company provides end-to-end domestic and international logistics solutions, covering air, sea, rail, and land transportation, as well as warehousing and last-mile delivery services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced digital and intelligent technologies such as AI algorithms, large language models, autonomous vehicles, automated sorting centers, and robotic process automation (RPA) to enhance operational efficiency and customer service. It has developed proprietary logistics decision-making models and integrates IoT, cloud computing, blockchain, and automation to build a smart supply chain ecosystem.
categories.primary_customers_markets: S.F. Holding serves a diverse customer base including e-commerce platforms, manufacturers, trade enterprises, cross-border e-commerce businesses, and individual consumers. Key industries served include high-end manufacturing, automotive, pharmaceuticals, fresh produce, consumer goods, and telecommunications. The company targets both domestic Chinese markets and international markets, especially in Asia and expanding globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, covering all prefecture-level cities and nearly all counties, with a strong presence in Hong Kong and other Asian countries such as Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Singapore, and Indonesia. It also has growing operations in Europe, the Americas, and other global regions through its international logistics network and subsidiaries.
categories.supply_chain_position: S.F. Holding operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the logistics supply chain, providing integrated logistics services including transportation, warehousing, distribution, and last-mile delivery. It also offers upstream supply chain solutions such as inventory management and end-to-end supply chain optimization for clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on accelerating industry-specific logistics solutions, expanding international logistics capabilities, and deepening digital transformation through R&D in AI, automation, and smart supply chain technologies. It aims to enhance operational efficiency, reduce costs, and provide customized, intelligent logistics services. Sustainability and green logistics innovation are also strategic priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through service fees from logistics and freight forwarding services, including express delivery, freight transport, cold chain logistics, same-city delivery, and supply chain management. Additional income comes from leasing, technology services, and investment returns. The company also earns revenue from international logistics and cross-border e-commerce logistics solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: S.F. Holding is the largest logistics service provider in China and Asia and ranks as the fourth largest global comprehensive logistics provider. It holds leading market positions in express delivery, freight transport, cold chain, and same-city delivery segments in China and Asia. Competitors include other major Chinese and international logistics firms, but S.F. maintains a competitive edge through its integrated network, technology, and service quality.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 284.4 billion, representing a 10.1% year-over-year growth. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 10.2 billion, up 23.5% from the previous year. The company has a robust asset base exceeding RMB 2.1 trillion and continues to invest in network expansion and technology, demonstrating steady growth and strong profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: S.F. Holding emphasizes high-quality, reliable, and time-sensitive logistics services with a strong brand reputation synonymous with premium express delivery in China. Its unique value lies in integrated end-to-end logistics solutions powered by advanced digital technologies, extensive network coverage, and customized industry-specific services. The company also prioritizes sustainability and green logistics, offering innovative low-carbon solutions to customers.
